# personio fixtures

Real response from a public, unauthenticated endpoint (one request, User-Agent
`RumoJobSearch/0.1.0 (uso pessoal)`), captured on 2026-11-14.

- URL: https://dci.jobs.personio.de/xml
- file(s): positions.xml
- original size: 133,867 bytes
- original items: 25 positions
- kept: first 5 positions (copied verbatim as text, CDATA preserved)

Trimming: item objects are unmodified (re-serialised as indented UTF-8 JSON).
E-mail addresses inside the data are replaced by `removido@example.test`. No personal
data of candidates.

Robots: https://dci.jobs.personio.de/robots.txt = `User-agent: *` / `Allow: /` (200). No `<!DOCTYPE` in the response. Company: dci (Digital Career Institute), found by web search.
